providers.comment: XianGong Cloud prefers /root/mcminimaxh3 only; generic scanner will verify and pick /mnt only when it is a real separate data disk. Add new vendors here; no need to ship a new exe.
LightCC auto-expanding data disk is /root/lightcc-tmp. Never deploy to /mnt, which is the 30G container overlay.
ZhiChuan Cloud (gpuhome.cc) data disk is /root/rivermind-data; system disk / is a 30G overlay, never deploy there.
